geometric-series-ratios.alt: Partial sums 1 + r + ... + r to the n (the first n + 1 terms) for n = 0 to 10, one dot each, for three ratios. Left, r = 1/2: the partial sums 1, 1.5, 1.75, ... rise toward the dashed line at 2, the sum 1/(1 − 1/2). Middle, r = −1/2: the partial sums 1, 0.5, 0.75, 0.625, ... zigzag in toward 2/3, the sum 1/(1 + 1/2). Right, r = 5/4: the partial sums grow without bound, so the series diverges.
